title: Near-factorizations in association schemes
summary: We formally initiate the study of $λ$-fold $(s,t)$ near-factorizations in association schemes. Namely, given an association $(X, \mathcal{A})$, we consider the existence of a factorization of $λ(J-I)$ into 01-matrices $S$ and $T$ with the constraint that $S$ and $T$ must belong to the adjacency algebra of $(X, \mathcal{A})$. We establish basic properties of $λ$-fold $(s,t)$ near-factorizations in association schemes and calculate bounds for $λ$, $s$, and $t$ relative to the order of the association scheme.
